title: Fish Hat
wikitext:
{{Infobox/Armor piece |rarity = Common |id = FISH_HAT |collection = Raw Cod I |museum = yes |museum_xp = 1 |museum_category = fishing |sell = 24 |health = +5 |raw_materials = 8 Raw Cod |mat_cost_bazaar = 8 Raw Cod }} The '''Fish Hat''' is a {{Common}} [[Helmet]] unlocked at {{CollectionLink|Raw Cod I}}. As of [[Changelog/2019/November 11|v0.7.4]], it can be used in conjunction with a [[Magical Water Bucket]] and [[Raw Cod]] to turn the [[Melancholic Viking]] into a Joyful Viking, allowing you to access his shop. == Obtaining == === Crafting === {{Crafting Recipe Table |{{Crafting Recipe Row |requirement = {{Coll|Raw Cod I}} |A1 = Raw Cod |B1 = Raw Cod |A2 = Raw Cod |C2 = Raw Cod |C1 = Raw Cod |Output = Fish Hat }} }} == Usage == {{ItemInfo |type = Helmet |name = Fish Hat |rarity = Common |health = 5 |item_ability_name = Splash |item_ability_activation = Sneak |item_ability_description = Crouch to splash some water around. |item_ability_mana_cost = 10 |item_ability_cooldown = 1s }} == Trivia == * The model is based on the Pokémon [[Bulb:Magikarp_(Pokémon)|Magikarp]]. Other items like [[Blessed Bait]] and the [[Flying Fish Pet]] were recolored versions of the hat. * When the Splash ability is used, a message saying "It's not very effective..." will appear in the chat. This is a reference to Magikarp's iconic useless move, [[Bulb:Splash_(move)|Splash]]. The message refers to a move hitting a Pokémon with a resisting type. * This item is part of the [[Melancholic Viking|Melancholic Viking's]] quest. == Showcase == {{YouTube|QIMpdgk_k8w|caption=Fish Hat Showcase}}
